codeReview.summary: The worker wrote a comprehensive test suite simulating A2A integration, but completely failed to implement the actual integration wiring in the router product code. The commit only contains test file additions and a minor schema update in task-state-machine.cjs. The router itself was never wired to dispatch tasks to the channel session via A2A HTTP.

issues.description: Missing integration wiring. The router should dispatch tasks to channel session via A2A HTTP, but no router code was modified to use A2AClient.

summary: Failed because the worker did not actually modify the router to use A2A. The worker only wrote tests that simulate the router's behavior.
